descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S07 Recording length: one sentence, five in one take, ten in one take, a 3-minute take

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • T3 Dictation does not crash the tab. (TFA-94423 AC 8)
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery. (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total. (UAT 3.5)
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 6; TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Same setup as S01; the live session commits audio only at Stop and gives up on the final 12 s after Stop, then recovers the kept recording with whisper-1 (TFA-94745)

When Dictate L-01…L-04 into the Hospital pre-round box as one take each; L-02 also into the Nursing Home Pre-Round box and Nursing Home Encounter Dictate

Then At every length each sentence appears exactly as many times as it was dictated, with its own checks holding on its own segment; if the live final times out the kept recording is transcribed automatically and lands once, with no error shown when that recovery succeeds; the tab stays responsive

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The transcript is split per sentence in dictation order at each item's anchor; each segment must pass that sentence's own S01/S02 checks (numbers, boundaries), so one sentence's numbers cannot satisfy another's; occurrences = times dictated (1, or 2 for L-04) (U1, T6). 'The last phrase couldn't finish transcribing' without automatic recovery, or a missing sentence, is a Fail; …

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Not judged yet: long takes (ten sentences, three minutes) are blocked on the same OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/94839fad…: scripted L-02 passes 3/3 on the three surfaces. L-01/L-03/L-04 and the 12 s final window need the live engine, so they wait on the key.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S07

Recording length: one sentence, five in one take, ten in one take, a 3-minute take

Tickets: TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-dictation: status blocked in aicheck-dictation/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-dictation/plan.json, automatable: yes): live: join item audio with 2-3 s pauses into one take (L-01..L-04), split the read transcript at each anchor in dictation order, run each sentence's checks on its own segment, occurrences, tabAlive; note the 12 s final-timeout message and any transcribeAudio row. Scripted mode proves only tabAlive and the split logic. — Engine behaviour on long takes is the point; key precondition only.

Detail:

laneB-preconditions not met: the local OPENAI_API_KEY ends …PUMA and there is no OK on record from Quinn that it is not the key dev uses (her 2026-10-09 notes say it may be), so no audio was sent to OpenAI. Run after that OK: QA_DICT_MODE=live QA_DICTATION_LIVE_OK=PUMA scripts/aicheck-dictation/run.sh. harness self-test with the scripted far end: 3/3 long takes landed in the box and passed the checks (shim, Dictate/Stop, read rule, engine attribution, checks.ts). The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used. Scripted self-test ran L-02 on Hospital pre-round, NH Pre-Round and NH Encounter (split by anchor, per-sentence checks, tab alive); L-01/L-03/L-04 and the 12 s final window need the live engine.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
